title: Lighting quote, unsure and then decided
transcript:
Chris Paul (owner): The back room is too dark for evening classes.
Chris Paul (owner): I'm not sure about the $900 lighting package from Stage Left.
Chris Paul (owner): OK I've decided. I'll pay Stage Left $900 for the lighting on Friday.

traps.description: Chris says he is not sure about $900. The draft quotes that sentence instead of the later decision.
